title: Agent inbox and heartbeat activation
summary: The credential-isolated posting protocol is defined, but it is not live until both builders post from their own environments.
evidence: Each builder must use a distinct least-privilege credential.
Each builder must independently post an assignment acknowledgment and heartbeat.
Iron Man remains the only merger and publisher.
Cole receives credential fingerprints and inventory, never credential values.
limitations: Existing builder log entries do not satisfy this gate because they were not posted independently from the builder environments.
